threads.body: This adds v4 without upgrading the YAML parser: `contract.go:23` still imports `go.yaml.in/yaml/v3`, so `load()` continues to use v3.0.6 and the new dependency is unused. To complete the advertised upgrade, update that import to `/v4`, replace the v3 requirement, and regenerate `go.sum`.
threads.hunk:
@@ -2,4 +2,7 @@ module github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-conformance/tools/http/tes
 
 go 1.25.0
 
-require go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 v3.0.6
+require (
+	go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 v3.0.6
+	go.yaml.in/yaml/v4 v4.0.0
